title: PZ.P WD-315 12V/24V Battery Charger Maintainer

comparisons.notes: New condition, MPN WD-315, orange, 0-15A 12V/24V with clips, 6.5x7.5x3.75 in, 2.86 lb, matching the PZ.P WD-315; in stock (last unit).

writeup: PZ.P's WD-315 manual battery charger and maintainer is $45.99 new at Woot, while an eBay seller lists the same model for $170.99. It handles 12V and 24V batteries with an adjustable 0-15A output, plus built-in desulfation and pulse maintenance. Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B09G29Y63H verified by checker as the exact PZ.P WD-315.
